The '''Breshkall system''' was situated in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Khuiumin sector/Legends|Khuiumin sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the site of [[Breshkall]], a hidden base used by the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Arms dealer/Legends|arms dealer]] [[Prengahl Kreen]], who operated in<ref name="H&R" /> the [[Hook Nebula/Legends|Hook Nebula's]]<ref name="EAOC" /> [[Empartheca system/Legends|Empartheca system]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Kreen did not do business at Breshkall, instead using it as a refuge and home for his family, friends, servants, and trusted associates. The base was rumored to be a floating [[Fortress/Legends|fortress]], and uninvited visitors were not welcome there.<ref name="H&R" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Breshkall [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square O-19.<ref name="TEA" />
